findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Re-parent this ADR-0111 shim-removal leaf under the epic/story that owns src/ and scripts/ shim migration (or create/correct that parent), since 3f35 (skaldic-paradoxal-huemul) and epic f400 both declare 'every file under src/ and scripts/' out of scope and the only overlapping deliverable (test_processors_status_split.py) is already owned and landed by the parent.
evidence: Parent 3f35 Scope: 'In scope: the 25 deleted files, the two new files, the renamed file, and the destinations named above. Out of scope: every file under src/ and scripts/, the Makefile, pyproject.toml, and every test module not named above.'

Parent 3f35 landing comment: 'Left as-is (out of this story's scope and file impact): ... prose mentions under src/ and docs/'; LLM-Review advisory: 'src/ is out of this story's scope; left for a comment sweep.'

Grandparent f400 epic: 'This epic touches only tests/, scripts/, pyproject.toml, Makefile, .gitignore, .pre-commit-config.yaml, and docs/' — targeting retirement of test-suite seam guards, not src/ shim migration; ADR 0111 is absent from both parent and grandparent.

Leaf Scope enumerates 'src/rebar/_engine_support/resolver.py (deleted)', 'src/rebar/reducer/{_processors,_replay}.py', 'the listed src/rebar/** importers', 'scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py', and leaf Approach edits 'src/rebar/_ids.py', 'src/rebar/_alias.py' — all src/ and scripts/ work the parent forbids.

The only in-parent overlap is the test_processors_status_split.py DELETE-BUT-MOVE, which the parent itself performs and already landed (441ca94f4a8); the leaf's own text treats this as a 'check whether it still exists' / 'skip if already gone' no-op, i.e. it duplicates rather than narrows the parent.
findings.finding: The leaf's core deliverables fall inside the region the parent (3f35, skaldic-paradoxal-huemul) explicitly declares OUT OF SCOPE ('every file under src/ and scripts/'), so the leaf is not a subset of its parent; it is a different (ADR-0111 shim-removal) story.
findings.location: Scope section; AC list (resolver.py delete, _processors.py / _replay.py rewrites, _processors.py F401 AC)
scenarios: Any merge/rebase after the parent landed: the leaf claims to own src/ and scripts/ migrations the parent and epic deliberately excluded, creating an untracked owner for ADR-0111 shim removal.
